C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 601
Date 2/10/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

September 29th 1918

Sir,
The Commander of the Sungkiang garrison, Woo Ling
Fong 何林豐 was called to Shanghai for an interview
with General Yang on the 28th inst. It is reported
that he received instructions to withdraw 200 cavalry
from Fungching 楓 to Sungkiang. Their places will be
taken by Chekiang troops.
Zee Koh Liang 徐國樑 the Chief of Police has
instructed his detectives to try to locate 400 famine
refugees who are said to have recently arrived in Shanghai.
A number of dissatisfied rebels will hold a meeting
to-day at 8 a.m. in the Zee Oen 紅安 and Ong Tsung 鴻春
teashops, Avenue Joffre, Frenchtown.
The work of the Investigation Board of the repatriation
Bureau near the West Gate have not yet completed their work.
In the trouble between the master painters and their
employees there is no change in the situation.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：OK）
pages.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记
编号 601
日期 1916年10月2日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1918年9月29日

先生：

松江驻军司令何林豐（Woo Ling Fong）于本月28日奉召至上海，与杨将军会面。据报，他接到指令，将200名骑兵从枫泾（Fungching）撤至松江。其防务将由浙江军队接防。

警察局长徐國樑（Zee Koh Liang）已指示其侦探设法 locating 据称近期抵达上海的400名饥民难民。

一批不满的叛乱分子将于今日上午8时，在法租界霞飞路的红安（Zee Oen）茶馆和鸿春（Ong Tsung）茶馆举行会议。

西门附近遣返局调查委员会的工作尚未完成。

在画师师傅与其雇员之间的纠纷中，局势未有变化。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

（批：OK）
